evals.name: blog-component-related-e2e
evals.prompt: 我改了 packages/theme/src/components/blog/BlogMain.vue，帮我本地跑一下该跑的测试；unit 全量跑，e2e 只跑相关的。
evals.expected_output: Should choose quick local mode, run or propose `pnpm test:unit`, then select `pnpm -F vitepress-clear-blog test:e2e -- e2e/BlogMain.spec.ts`, and mention CI-aligned checks are still needed before PR.

evals.name: d3-related-e2e
evals.prompt: 这次主要改了 D3ForceGraph 和 d3Utils，跑测试别全量 e2e，挑相关的。
evals.expected_output: Should choose quick local mode, include full root unit tests, and select D3-related specs such as D3ForceGraph.spec.ts, D3PageGraph.spec.ts, D3PageSidebar.spec.ts, D3FullScreen.spec.ts, or explain the selected subset based on exact changed files.

evals.name: global-layout-full-e2e
evals.prompt: 我动了 NewLayout.vue 和主题入口，帮我设计本地验证命令。
evals.expected_output: Should run `pnpm test:unit`, select related local e2e specs instead of defaulting to naked `pnpm test:e2e`, and include `pnpm typecheck` because shared layout/theme entry changes are broad.

evals.name: plugin-unit-typecheck-no-e2e
evals.prompt: 我只改了 vitepress-plugin-analyzer 的 parser 逻辑，怎么本地检查？
evals.expected_output: Should run root `pnpm test:unit`, skip Playwright e2e unless docs/theme rendering changed, and add `pnpm typecheck` for plugin/API confidence.

evals.name: lint-no-mutation
evals.prompt: 顺手 lint 一下，但不要改我的文件。
evals.expected_output: Should avoid root `pnpm lint` because it uses `eslint --fix`, and instead use non-mutating `pnpm exec eslint './packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,vue}'`.

evals.name: pr-ci-aligned-full-check
evals.prompt: 准备提 PR 了，按 CI 门禁帮我列一下本地要跑哪些检查，lint 和 typecheck 也得过。
evals.expected_output: Should choose PR/CI-aligned mode and include `pnpm lint; git diff --exit-code`, `bash scripts/check-e2e-coverage.sh`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:unit`, `pnpm build`, and targeted related E2E via `pnpm -F vitepress-clear-blog test:e2e -- e2e/<Spec>.spec.ts` rather than naked `pnpm test:e2e`, plus note the commit check if validating the current commit.

evals.name: ci-lint-mutating-command
evals.prompt: 我要和 GitHub Actions 完全一致地跑 lint，本地怎么跑？
evals.expected_output: Should recommend the CI command `pnpm lint; git diff --exit-code`, explain that `pnpm lint` may modify files through `eslint --fix`, and say to inspect/commit any resulting diff.

evals.name: e2e-coverage-check
evals.prompt: 我新增了一个 theme 组件和 e2e spec，除了跑测试还要检查啥？
evals.expected_output: Should include `bash scripts/check-e2e-coverage.sh` because CI checks E2E coverage, plus unit tests and targeted related E2E specs based on the changed component/spec. It should not default to full local E2E unless requested or clearly necessary.
